description: This Java source file defines a JUnit test case class 'RmTypeDefsTest' that creates temporary Java source files with typedef annotations, compiles them, runs a tool 'RmTypeDefs' to process the output, and verifies the correctness of generated class files. It also handles directory traversal and cleanup.

classes.name: RmTypeDefsTest
